column1: # These capture exit code, stdout and stderr - scrubbed of paths, timings and
# traceback line numbers - plus whether the output folder was created and how
# many entries it has (PORTING.md Finding 17: every validation failure still
# does mkdir_p on the outfolder before it fails).
# Unlike the output matrix, these run in well under a second and need no corpus
# beyond the repo's own test/ files, so they are the fastest possible signal
# that the port's argument handling has drifted.
# {OUT} is replaced with a fresh empty temp directory.
# {REF} {GTF} {READS} are replaced with the repo's test fixtures.
